name: How long does a typical drafty window repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical drafty window repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a drafty window repair depends on the number of windows and the complexity of the issues. Minor repairs like re-caulking or weatherstripping can often be completed in a few hours per window. More involved repairs, such as adjusting or repairing a sash or frame, might take longer. We strive to complete repairs efficiently while ensuring quality, and we will provide an estimated timeline during your initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on the issue's complexity and number of windows, from a few hours for minor fixes to longer for structural repairs.
